setup.title: Setup guide
setup.subtitle: Go step by step — each task takes a few minutes.
setup.allDoneDescription: Company info, catalog, and quoting are ready. Create and send your next estimate.

company.title: Enter your company name
company.description: Trade name shown at the top of estimates and invoices.
company.tip: Use the name customers know — e.g. "Smith Electric LLC".

contact.title: Add contact details
contact.description: At least email or phone so clients can reach you.
contact.tip: Use the same number you give customers on site.

address.title: Enter your business address
address.description: Full address printed on PDF documents.

tax.title: Add tax information
tax.description: Tax ID for invoices and official documents.
tax.tip: EIN in the US; VAT number in the EU.

quoteDefaults.title: Set quote defaults
quoteDefaults.description: Markup, tax rate, currency, and standard terms.

items.title: Add items to your catalog
items.description: Save materials and labor you use on every job.
items.tip: Units: sq ft, hour, each — add to quotes in one tap.

clients.title: Add your first client
clients.description: Name, phone, address — quick pick when quoting.
clients.tip: Start with one real customer; duplicate later.

firstEstimate.title: Create your first estimate
firstEstimate.description: Pick a client, add lines, export PDF or share link.
firstEstimate.tip: Save as draft first, send when ready.

logo.title: Add your logo
logo.description: Logo URL makes documents look more professional.
logo.tip: Square PNG, at least 200×200 px recommended.

license.title: License or insurance info
license.description: Extra trust line — contractor license, insurance summary.
license.tip: Optional but helps win bigger jobs.

materials.title: Positionskatalog
materials.formDescription: Häufige Positionen speichern und per Tippen hinzufügen.
materials.itemDatabaseDescription: Name, Einheit (m², Stunden, Stück) und Stückkosten.
materials.confirmDelete: Diese Position aus dem Katalog löschen?
materials.bannerDescription: Like Joist's item list: price once, reuse on every quote. Tap to add instead of retyping on site.

clients.title: Kunden
clients.emptyDescription: Ersten Kunden hinzufügen, um Angebote zu erstellen.
clients.deleteHasQuotes: Löschen nicht möglich — verknüpfte Angebote vorhanden.
clients.bannerDescription: All contact details in one place. Select a client when building a quote — no copy-paste.

quotes.title: Angebote
quotes.emptyDescription: Erstes Angebot in unter 2 Minuten erstellen.
quotes.listBannerDescription: Search by number or client. Change status as the job progresses: Draft → Sent → Approved or Declined.

quoteBuilder.title: Angebotserstellung
quoteBuilder.successDescription: Bereit zum Versand. PDF laden oder alle Angebote ansehen.
quoteBuilder.bannerDescription: Four steps: client → line items → markup & tax → save & PDF. Totals update live as you type.
quoteBuilder.reviewHint: Review totals before saving. You can download PDF and email it to your client.

hints.selectClient: Who will receive this quote? Add new clients without leaving this page.
hints.markup: Profit margin applied to subtotal (e.g. 20% covers overhead and profit).
hints.tax: Sales tax or VAT applied after markup.

hints.notes: Payment terms, warranty, scope. Pre-filled from Settings if configured.
hints.deposit: Request a deposit before work begins — Joist Basics.
hints.personalMessage: A personal note included on the estimate for your client.
